summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Uganda High Commission National ID Appointment Booking System. Main user booking flow working perfectly. Critical admin dashboard issue found.

minor_issues.issue: Returns 200 status code instead of 201 for successful creation
minor_issues.impact: Does not affect functionality, just incorrect HTTP status

security_issues.issue: Does not require authentication - allows unauthorized access to admin statistics

critical_bugs.issue: JavaScript runtime errors prevent admin dashboard from loading
critical_bugs.error_message: A <SelectItem /> must have a value prop that is not an empty string
critical_bugs.impact: Completely blocks admin functionality from UI

passed_tests: Landing page loads with hero section and services display
Book Appointment button navigates to booking form
Step 1: Personal details form validation works
Step 2: Service selection with requirements display
Step 3: Calendar date selection (only Tue/Wed/Fri available)
Form submission creates appointment and navigates to confirmation
Confirmation page displays appointment details and reference number
PDF download button works (client-side jsPDF generation)
Backend API endpoints (health, services, disabled-dates, appointments)

action_item_for_main_agent.issue: Fix admin dashboard React Select components - add proper value props to SelectItem components in AdminDashboard.jsx
action_item_for_main_agent.details: SelectItem components are missing value props causing runtime errors and preventing admin UI from loading

action_item_for_main_agent.issue: Add authentication requirement to admin stats endpoint
action_item_for_main_agent.details: Admin stats endpoint should verify JWT token before returning data
